applicability.expression_language: allowlisted conjunction of == comparisons on encounter.kind and the FR-21 effect status only; no arithmetic, no function calls, no note access (proposed for owner review; the S25 allowlist parser is authoritative)
required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: effect absent yields not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior; a false gate is never a negative posterior). Effect not_assessed, missing, or conflicting yields needs_clarification and stops later questions; saving corrected input creates a new run. Missing required non-gate input (severity when present, airway assessment) yields needs_clarification. Missing optional input (phase, association, safety, older vulnerability, burden, recurrence need, preference concern) leaves that node as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure.

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All declared states (including unknown_incomplete where declared) are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations (undeclared node/state, conflicting evidence on one node).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: effect absent is handled at the gate (not_applicable), not here. Effect present with missing severity, or missing effect record, yields needs_clarification (blocks).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; clinician rating recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.typed_transform: without_involvement iff effect status present AND severity without_speech_swallowing_or_breathing_involvement; speech_swallowing_involvement iff present AND severity speech_or_swallowing_involvement; breathing_stridor_involvement iff present AND severity breathing_difficulty_or_stridor. Present-without-severity is required-missing (needs_clarification), never defaulted.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: airway field absent yields needs_clarification (required input blocks) until reviewed and collected, even when severity is non-breathing. Severity breathing with an explicit absent airway record is a conflict and blocks.
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff severity breathing_difficulty_or_stridor OR the proposed airway field records suspected laryngeal involvement/stridor; absent_assessed iff severity is without/speech involvement AND the proposed field records no concern. Deterministic urgent flag fires from this saved value without waiting for any model output.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until the field is reviewed and collected (permits inference; renders assess_episode_and_differential when the pathway would otherwise treat).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter assessment; recent episode linkage retained separately per BN-11 time_window
patient_mappings.typed_transform: active iff clinician records current contractions/postures now; resolved_recent iff clinician records a recent episode clinically resolved and under prevention review in this encounter (the effect status present documents the index episode in the review window; proposed linkage for owner review); else unknown_incomplete. BN-11 NoEpisode is folded into the gate (absent yields not_applicable).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; renders assess_episode_and_differential).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter for the assessment; days-scale onset lookback and medication-change history where recorded
patient_mappings.typed_transform: established iff clinician records the index episode associated with antipsychotic exposure after onset-timing review (days since initiation, rapid escalation, or preventive anti-EPS reduction), medication review (including dopamine-blocking antiemetics and preventive anticholinergic changes), distribution/persistence review, and exclusion review (catatonia, primary neurological/medical cause, tardive movement disorder); not_established iff an alternative explanation is recorded or the exclusions redirect the workup; else unknown_incomplete. Never inferred from severity, medication presence, or treatment response alone (a rapid treatment response supports but does not replace differential diagnosis per the criteria source).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician records patient-specific anticholinergic adverse effects or susceptibility (cognitive, urinary, bowel, ocular including narrow-angle risk, cardiac, thermoregulatory); absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. Specifics preserved; no blanket exclusion invented.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician assesses age-related vulnerability to anticholinergic harms; absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. No numeric age threshold is recorded.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician records concomitant anticholinergic exposure of concern (antipsychotics, antidepressants, urological drugs, antihistamines); absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. No burden-score cutoff is recorded.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter assessment after resolution, where applicable
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician assesses an ongoing need to consider recurrence prevention while the causative regimen is reviewed; absent_assessed iff clinician records no such need; else unknown_incomplete. Not a measured recurrence probability.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff an assessed patient concern or preference against continued anticholinergic treatment is recorded; absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete. Absence does not establish consent.

reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branch rendered as review prompt only; maximum posterior is not a recommendation rule; deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs shown first and never waits for LLM; safety, continuation, and regimen posteriors always rendered alongside the pathway branch; unknown_disclosure always appended; needs_clarification branch on required missing/conflict; not_applicable branch on gate-absent
